description: 45 templated /product/N.html pages, all sharing a byte-identical title and meta description (a realistic templating mistake), linked from one catalog.html hub which also carries several ?sort= facet-parameter links. Default crawl budget is 30 pages; BFS order (home, about, catalog, then the ?sort= facet links, then products 1..N) means the crawl exhausts its budget partway through the product list.

findings.title: Crawl budget burned by parameter URLs in /catalog.html
findings.mechanism: A crawler with a fixed page budget that spends it on filter/sort combinations never reaches the actual content pages.
findings.impact: Substantive pages behind this template may go undiscovered.
findings.observed_signal: 80% of discovered URLs in /catalog.html carry a query string, and the crawl exhausted its budget
findings.evidence: Parameter URLs: http://127.0.0.1:54739/catalog.html?sort=name, http://127.0.0.1:54739/catalog.html?sort=newest, http://127.0.0.1:54739/catalog.html?sort=price, http://127.0.0.1:54739/catalog.html?sort=rating

suggested_action.summary: Disallow or canonicalize low-value parameter combinations so budget reaches substantive URLs.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add robots.txt rules or canonical tags for facet/sort parameters.
suggested_action.validation: Re-crawl under the same budget; discovery reaches the previously unreached substantive URLs.

description: Numeric-ID article URLs (/article/101.html etc, should cluster as /article/# per template_shape). /old-page.html -> /new-page.html is a single-hop redirect (must NOT fire D-CRAWL-05). /a.html -> /b.html -> /c.html -> /d.html is a 3-hop chain (must fire D-CRAWL-05). /en/pricing.html and /fr/pricing.html are locale variants with no hreflang tag anywhere (D-CRAWL-11). /gone.html returns HTTP 200 with a short soft-404 phrase (D-CRAWL-04).

findings.title: Dead or soft-404 pages in /gone.html
findings.mechanism: A dead page cannot be read regardless of what a sitemap or internal link claims.
findings.impact: Links and sitemap entries pointing here lead nowhere.
findings.observed_signal: 1 page(s) dead or soft-404
findings.evidence: Broken: http://127.0.0.1:54828/gone.html

suggested_action.summary: Fix the broken route, 301 to the correct resource, or remove the dead link/sitemap entry.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Restore or redirect the named URLs.
suggested_action.validation: Re-fetch; status is 200 and the soft-404 phrase no longer matches.

findings.title: Locale variants with no hreflang (*/pricing.html)
findings.mechanism: Ambiguous locale signals split citation authority across duplicates and risk serving the wrong-language version to a crawler.
findings.impact: These locale variants compete instead of consolidating signal.
findings.observed_signal: 2 locale variant(s), none carry hreflang
findings.evidence: Variants: http://127.0.0.1:54828/en/pricing.html, http://127.0.0.1:54828/fr/pricing.html

suggested_action.summary: Add self- and cross-referencing hreflang tags across every locale variant.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add <link rel=alternate hreflang=...> for each variant on every variant.
suggested_action.validation: Re-fetch each variant; a consistent, mutually-referencing hreflang set is present.

findings.title: Redirect chain faults in /a.html
findings.mechanism: Each hop is a chance for a crawler to give up, and adds latency against the crawl-budget ceiling every citation pipeline has.
findings.impact: Slower, less reliable discovery of these URLs.
findings.observed_signal: 1 URL(s) with >=3 hops or a loop
findings.evidence: Long/looping chains: http://127.0.0.1:54828/a.html

suggested_action.summary: Collapse the chain to a single redirect straight to the final canonical URL.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Update the redirect rule(s) to a direct hop.
suggested_action.validation: Re-fetch the original URL; redirect_chain length is <=1.
